title: Where is it?
intro: In, on, under, next to, between. Today’s grammar and words, and what we learnt before.
intro_uz: Ichida, ustida, tagida, yonida, orasida. Bugungi grammatika, so’zlar va oldingi mavzular.
message: Lesson 9 · Where is it? Do it before the next lesson. Rasmga oling yoki chop eting.

parts.title: In, on, under, next to, between
items: The cat is {on|under} the bed. (karavot tagida)
The bank is between the café {and|or} the shop.
{What|Where} is my phone? — It’s on the sofa.
Is the book on the desk? — No, it {isn’t|aren’t}.

parts.title: Write the place word
parts.uz: Joy so’zini yozing: o’zbekcha so’zga qarang
items: Lola is sitting ___ Madina and Aziz. (orasida)

parts.title: Negatives and questions
items: The book is on the desk.
The keys are in your bag.
The cat is under the table.
The shoes are next to the door.
There is a bank next to the bazaar.

parts.title: Put the words in order
items: on / The plov / the table / is
between / is sitting / Lola / Aziz and Madina
the school / The bank / next to / is
under / Is / the bed / the cat / ?

parts.title: What we learnt before
items: There {is|are} two shelves in my room.

items.prompt: Write 6 sentences about your room or your home. Use in, on, under, next to, between.
items.hint: Example: My bed is next to the window. There is a carpet on the floor.
